name: review-run-binding-race
title: Relax the id-recency review-run binding so a concurrent review_run_start no longer strands a material-fresh pass
description: When reviewer lanes run in parallel (or a reviewer retries review_run_start), a second run_start on the same lane mints a newer reviewRunId and any pass/finding bound to the original run is hard-rejected purely by id-recency, even when it is still material- and scope-fresh. This stalls quorum_submit and forced a whole fresh REVIEW round in B-70e4. Relax the id-recency rejection (the freshness + scope checks are the real authorities), kind-aware so open findings still surface, conditioned on an empty-set storyFilesHash no-signal guard.
